_help: Lecture config template: copy to lessons/<id>/video_project_config.json and fill the 3 REQUIRED fields. Every other setting defaults to config/defaults.json; override any of them under 'overrides' with the same section names (project, sync, editing, layout, zoom, color, graphics, captions, transcription, audio, thumbnails, youtube, shorts, output, qa). Check with: python -m ytpipe init --config <file>
